context.canonical_title: 如何实现消息处理的 exactly-once 业务效果？

required_checks: Resolve the mixed-source-question-type risk from authoritative context before judging scope; reject a merged answer if source variants require distinct Canonicals.
Verify Kafka 4.3 producer idempotence, transactional.id, sendOffsetsToTransaction and read_committed/LSO semantics against current Apache Kafka primary sources.

Verify MySQL 8.4 InnoDB transaction semantics and the processed_event dedup invariant, including explicit NOT NULL key columns because MySQL UNIQUE indexes permit multiple NULL values; distinguish database atomicity from MQ acknowledgement and external API effects.

Verify outbox relay claims against current Debezium official documentation and require a stable non-null event id plus downstream idempotency/result-query/compensation boundaries for non-database side effects.
Check stable event-id scope, concurrent duplicate races, retention/replay windows, offset ordering, ambiguous sends, DLQ/recovery, observability and capacity reasoning.
Verify all source variants are directly answered and hypothetical project examples cannot be read as fabricated personal experience.
review_contract.promotion_boundary: Do not promote or fabricate human approval. Pilot human review remains a separate mandatory gate when required by config.

primary_sources_to_verify_independently.title: Apache Kafka 4.3 Producer Configs
claims_to_check: enable.idempotence guarantees one copy for producer retries within its documented boundary and is enabled by default when configs do not conflict
idempotence requires acks=all, retries greater than zero and max.in.flight.requests.per.connection less than or equal to five

primary_sources_to_verify_independently.title: Apache Kafka 4.3.1 KafkaProducer API
claims_to_check: transactional.id enables transactional producer APIs and idempotence
sendOffsetsToTransaction marks offsets as part of the current transaction and they commit only if the transaction commits
Kafka transactional guarantees require transaction-aware downstream consumption

primary_sources_to_verify_independently.title: Apache Kafka 4.3 Consumer Configs
claims_to_check: read_committed returns only committed transactional messages
read_committed is bounded by the last stable offset while transactions are open

primary_sources_to_verify_independently.title: MySQL 8.4 Introduction to InnoDB
claims_to_check: InnoDB DML follows ACID transactions with commit, rollback and crash recovery

primary_sources_to_verify_independently.title: MySQL 8.4 PRIMARY KEY and UNIQUE Index Constraints
claims_to_check: duplicate primary/unique-key values produce constraint violations with transactional rollback behavior

primary_sources_to_verify_independently.title: MySQL 8.4 INFORMATION_SCHEMA COLUMNS
claims_to_check: a UNIQUE index permits multiple NULL values, so correctness-critical dedup columns must independently be NOT NULL

primary_sources_to_verify_independently.title: Debezium Outbox Event Router
claims_to_check: the default outbox event id is not null and provides a unique event id usable for duplicate removal
outbox relay does not itself make arbitrary external API side effects exactly-once

changes: made consumer_scope and event_id explicitly NOT NULL
defined the correctness boundary as a composite PRIMARY KEY or equivalent NOT NULL UNIQUE key
added empty/missing event_id fault-injection coverage and aligned the hypothetical project example
